question: Retake B Site Lotus 2v2, spike planted, 32s. You are Skye at B Main with your teammate at B Corner. How do you coordinate the 2v2 retake?

options.label: Use Guiding Light (flash) to open an angle and enter in trade with your teammate from two access points simultaneously
options.explication_courte: A 2v2 retake is won by coordination: flash to clear an angle and force a fight, simultaneous dual-entry through two access points prevents a post-plant hold from covering both.

options.label: Send the Trailblazer (tiger) as a scout to reveal ATK positions before committing to the entry
options.explication_courte: The Trailblazer gives info and can concuss an ATK, but in a 2v2 with 32s sending a scout costs defuse time and does not open the angle as cleanly as a coordinated flash.

sources_option.citation: Scouting utility gives info before a retake but costs defuse time; a coordinated flash-and-trade opens the angle more directly in a tight 2v2 window.

options.label: Enter solo through B Main while your teammate holds B Corner in backup
options.explication_courte: Entering solo in a 2v2 without an immediate trade gives an isolated 1v2 duel: if you die, your teammate is in a 1v2 with the retake coordination broken.

sources_option.citation: Entering a 2v2 retake solo without an immediate trade risks dropping the retaker into a 1v2; coordinated dual entries are the safer conversion.

options.label: Wait passively for the ATK to peek out of the site before engaging
options.explication_courte: Waiting in a 2v2 with the spike planted gives the round away: YOU must defuse - playing passive lets the clock run out and the ATK win by doing nothing.

sources_option.citation: In a spike-planted retake the defenders must act; playing passive lets the clock expire, handing the round to attackers who only need to survive on the plant.

explication_longue:
Situation: 2v2 retake on B Site Lotus, spike planted, 32 seconds. You are Skye at B Main with Trailblazer, Guiding Light, Regrowth; your teammate at B Corner.

2v2 retake principle: coordination. Two players entering simultaneously from two different access points force the 2 ATK into a coverage impossible - they can only hold one angle at a time. Skye's Guiding Light (flash) is the opener: flash an angle to create entry, both players push at the same moment through B Main and B Corner, and the first trade establishes the 1v1 you win from even numbers.

Trailblazer scout (acceptable) gives richer positional info and can concuss an ATK, but in a tight 2v2 with 32s on the clock, the defuse time cost and slower entry setup may not be worth the extra info. Entering solo (costly) breaks the coordination entirely - if you die it becomes a 1v2 with your teammate exposed. Passive waiting (mistake) concedes the round to the clock: the spike is planted and YOU must defuse.

Estimated elite distribution: ~55% flash + simultaneous dual-entry, ~22% Trailblazer scout first, ~15% solo entry (costly), ~6% passive wait (mistake).

sources.citation: A coordinated retake uses a flash to open an angle and simultaneous entries on distinct accesses to force a trade rather than a solo isolated duel.
In a spike-planted retake the defenders own the clock pressure and must act; a flash-and-trade entry beats scouting when the defuse window is short.
On Lotus B, the two distinct accesses let two defenders enter simultaneously to force a trade; solo entries risk dropping into a 1v2.

_gaps.incertitude: Estimations depuis guides retake/util (boostroom, boosteria) + Lotus (immortalboost) ; la frequence flash-entry vs Trailblazer-scout depend de la position ATK et du temps restant, sans dataset public.
Le Trailblazer scout (acceptable) peut monter optimal si les positions ATK sont tres incertaines et le timer plus large ; la frontiere depend du contexte non fixe ici (32s fixe pour trancher).
Positions x/y approximatives sur B Site Lotus (viewBox 1000x1000, zones de maps.ts) ; les positions ATK sont inconnues (2 inconnus, design) — ce que trancherait un juge.
